entries.note: release zip tried then source build (both flaky on determinism checks); three cracks compared in RAM; Remember's intro and manual read from memory; entry and loops traced
C64-Wiki, c64.com manual and review, Zzap 27 OCR, Wikipedia; attract, Wiztips and play screenshots
charsets rendered; text is PETSCII with FF terminators and a row/column prefix; 60 strings found in one sweep once the offset was known
register census and PETSCII string sweep from a local disassembly of the traced code; display lists and pointer tables resolved to seed the tracer
nine parallel annotation agents by address range (about an hour each), then the lead's own low RAM, the music driver's zero page and the stray unreferenced bytes; merging and spot checks

fourteen live tests; the level 5 stray tile took longest (a level poke too late for the map, then a random start position, then the continue keys); the lab-hang reachability argument; facts.md written from nine agents' notes

the rebuilt frame (per-interrupt registers and sprite pointers after a first render drew the beam for the ball), the landscape renderer and the ball port with their tests, and the music driver ported by one agent in parallel (an hour; exact on all nine tunes); the RAM-under-I/O sprites found and added to coverage on the way
kit edits (platform reference, four skills, the SID player), changelog, kit-feedback, game.json, TODO and cheats
